densitySummary.targetInterpretation: PM production target, not user-approved numerical parameter: new footprint about50-65% of preplacement free ground; green <=8-12%; small lawns not target to fill
precisionNotes: Analytic per-original-footprint areas are clipped to the sample then summed; overlaps can double count. Union figures use 0.5m raster instead.
Exact new-footprint sum uses shoelace and nonoverlapping rectangles; raster footprint area includes conservative edge pixels.
Free denominator excludes actual roads plus2.5m per-side sidewalk, conservative20m waterway+1m bank margin, original buildings+1.5m margin,5m entrance disks,1m sample edge.
Placement adds1m expanded mask around each new building; adjacent buildings retain about2m service/pedestrian spacing plus raster conservatism.
Paving includes required sidewalks, original-building setbacks, bank access, microcourtyards and residual alleys; it is not all a plaza.

renderNotes: renderGround=false built-block parcels are grouping/reference only; skip ground fill for them.
Other rings are evenodd, with original/new building holes retained.
Source buildings keep original footprints and heights; use sourceIndex for deterministic facade variation.
New styleProfile and streetFacingHint guide facade/shop orientation; they do not add routes or operating addresses.
